verdict.rationale: LangGraph is an open-source pip-installable library (langgraph-gh-5) with a CLI that runs a local dev server (langgraph-docs-28) and supports self-managed checkpointer backends like Postgres (langgraph-docs-13, langgraph-docs-27), confirming the core graph engine and persistence layer can run entirely self-hosted outside LangSmith. missing for 10: no first-party self-hosted 'production server' deployment guide (only local dev server and LangSmith-hosted deploy are documented), and no independent/community confirmation of a fully self-hosted production deployment pattern (community-8 raises deployment questions).
